location: a sun-warmed granite boulder on the hillside just beyond the jungle edge
canon_summary: James stepped out of the Great Canopy for the first time, leaving the trees behind to walk onto the open hillside. Sitting on a warm boulder, he quietly watched a thin wisp of smoke rise on the distant horizon.
world_lore: The Great Canopy is the vast, ancient jungle James has lived in his whole life. James's grounding ritual is closing his eyes to count three distinct sounds when nervous, and his habitual formal greeting to any unfamiliar horizon is: 'Pleased to meet you, whatever comes next.'
next_beat: By day 5, James should catch his first glimpse of human civilization in the distance -- a rooftop, smoke from a chimney, a distant sound of machinery -- something that hints a wider world exists beyond the jungle, without him reaching it yet.
